_why: Read by merge_train.py. Every number here is DERIVED from what this repo actually runs, never guessed.
_min_checks: MEASURED 2026-09-16 over the 30 most recently merged pull requests: 29 carried exactly 3 check runs on the head SHA (pytest, and the two compare jobs of style-standard) and one carried 4. The floor is 3. It is not 1: the state this catches is 'CI has not started', which reads 0.
_plugin: A plugin pull request is refused while a deploy has run inside the window. deploy-plugin.yml is dispatch-only here, so in practice the window is almost always open, but the rule is the same one the sibling tracker needs and it is read from the Actions API, never guessed.
_mechanical: The ONLY conflicts the train may resolve. docs/TECHLOG.md is append-only, so both entries are kept. docs/HANDOVER.md is deliberately absent: it is in self_heal.FORBIDDEN and it is how two sessions avoid colliding.
_forbidden: Refused BY NAME, so widening the allowlist can never reach them. This is self_heal.FORBIDDEN plus the reference material; tests/test_merge_train_config.py fails if self_heal grows an entry this list does not have.
_human_only: A check whose name contains any of these is NEVER healed, in any shape, including a cancel. A wrong number already published needs a person.
